ELECTRICITY — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits.
   B. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

4. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor
